description: AGSC-10-15 as amended for 1.1: the Level is the single source of the vector set, and a claim lists a Level's areas in one fixed order, the order in which AGSC-09-04 names the twenty-five areas, restricted to the areas the Level names (AGSC-10-02 to AGSC-10-05); no class sentence of AGSC-00-09 to AGSC-00-11 is consulted. It replaces conform-0003, which asserted the Level-1 list in the order AGSC-10-15 then left open. Derivation: AGSC-09-04 names frontmatter, slug, links, jcs, graph, lint, cli, bundle, prov, ledger, compose, build, discovery, adopt, import, export, skills, adapters, channels, harness, run, conform, boundary, chunks, boards. Level 0 names frontmatter, slug, bundle, discovery; Level 1 adds links, jcs, lint; Level 2 adds graph, build, adopt, ledger, import, export, skills, chunks, boards, boundary; Level 3 is all twenty-five.
